g.title: Rectangle.178
g.desc: BPDUs don’t reach all switches instantly—they take time to tr...
g.text: BPDUs don’t reach all switches instantly—they take time to travel. This delay can cause some switches to make decisions based on incomplete information. Port states, along with timers, ensure that each port waits long enough to receive the latest BPDUs before it starts forwarding frames.
